reasoning_steps: Identify the squirrels and their positions on the line.
Note the distance between each squirrel and the nuts.
Understand that the squirrels will run towards the nearest nut.
Determine which squirrel is closest to the first nut.
Conclude that the squirrel closest to the first nut will be the one to pick it up.
Identify the squirrel that picks the first nut and then runs to the next one.
